stemMd: What is the units digit of 7 to the power 43?
explanationMd: The units digits cycle 7,9,3,1 with period four. Since 43 leaves remainder 3 on division by 4, use the third position, 3.

distractorRationale.b: This corresponds to a multiple of four.
distractorRationale.d: This corresponds to exponent remainder one in the cycle.
distractorRationale.a: Powers of 7 are not multiples of ten.
